heading: Our Portfolio
paragraphs: As a full-service audiovisual production and event management company in Dili, we produce corporate, educational and promotional videos, TV, radio and cinema commercials and documentaries, with state-of-the-art equipment. We also offer film production services for clients from abroad.

We organise corporate and charity events, concerts, international conferences and road shows. Since 2019, the Dili International Film Festival (DIFF) brings entertainment and education to film lovers in Timor-Leste.
